story.heading:
First dates in
Burlington, VT
story.body: Wintertime hot toddies brought us together for our first dates in Burlington. And while timing wasn't on our side just yet, a beautiful seed was  planted.

story.heading:
Kept in touch
during the pandemic
story.body: Sarah got her master’s degree in Syracuse, Matt bought new a house Massachusetts, and the world changed drastically. The texts and Skype calls we shared were bright spots.

story.heading:
Reconnected
in the Poconos
story.body: We took a weekend trip the mountains to reconnect after Sarah returned home from Madrid. Our time turned into something neither of us expected—the start of everything.

story.heading:
Got engaged in
Hudson, NY
story.body: What Sarah thought was just an ‘off-site work trip’ to Hudson to meet Matt’s coworkers turned into the sweetest surprise: Matt proposed at the Maker Hotel, and Sarah said yes!

story.heading:
Sarah moved to
Massachusetts
story.body: After months of long‑weekend visits and countless 6-hour drives, we were ready to close the distance. Sarah moved in with Matt, making ‘his’ home theirs.

story.heading: Our big day in Lancaster
story.body: Lancaster became a big part of our story, so it’s only fitting to have friends, family, and everyone we love gathered in one place to celebrate with us. We can't wait!

celebration.heading: Our Celebration
celebration.description: We’re getting married at Excelsior in Lancaster, PA. It’s the perfect blend of old and new, and we can’t wait to kick off our new life together with great food, dancing, and your company.

infoRows.label: Weather & attire
infoRows.body: If the weather is kind to us, we’ll say our vows outdoors in the Garden Courtyard, and then head indoors to celebrate. We’d love for you to wear semi-formal or cocktail attire—dressy, but shy of a tux or gown.

infoRows.label: Location & parking
infoRows.body: Excelsior is located at 125 E King Street, one of the main roads in the city. While street parking is available throughout Lancaster, we’d recommend parking in the East King Parking Garage, located right across the street from Excelsior.

, located right across the street from Excelsior.

infoRows.label: Post-wedding fun
infoRows.body: While our reception wraps up at 10pm, the night doesn't have to end at Excelsior. There are plenty of bars within walking distance, and we’ll plan on visiting some for after party drinks.

infoRows.label: We kindly request an adults-only celebration
infoRows.body: We love your little ones, but our wedding ceremony and reception will be adults only. Thank you for understanding and for making arrangements ahead of time — we really appreciate it, and can’t wait to celebrate with you!

infoRows.label: Day-after brunch
infoRows.body: Sarah’s father and stepmother, Andrea and Leo Petrokonis, are graciously hosting a day-after brunch at their Airbnb next to Excelsior. Please join us for bagels and refreshments before leaving town.

travel.heading: Travel & Stay
travel.body: Lancaster is a beautiful destination with plenty to explore. Here are our recommendations to make your visit memorable.
travel.whereToStayFineprint: *With so many great hotels and Airbnbs near the venue, we skipped the room block. Please feel free to book whatever fits your style and budget.

whereToStay.heading: Lancaster Marriott at Penn Square
whereToStay.body: A 1-minute walk from our venue—the closest hotel to the ceremony, and home to Plough downstairs.

whereToStay.heading: Holiday Inn Lancaster
whereToStay.body: A 7-minute walk from our venue. Solid, affordable, convenient — a clean place to land for the night.

whereToStay.heading: Lancaster Arts Hotel
whereToStay.body: A 5-minute drive from our venue. A boutique stay with rotating local art and a design-forward feel.

whereToStay.heading: Cork Factory Hotel
whereToStay.body: A 5-minute drive from our venue, set in a converted historic factory with brick-and-beam character.

whereToStay.heading: Eden Resort & Suites
whereToStay.body: A 12-minute drive from our venue, with resort amenities and a pool for guests staying the weekend.

whereToStay.heading: The Inn at Leola Village
whereToStay.body: A 17-minute drive from our venue, set in a quaint country village setting just outside the city.

whereToEat.heading: Luca
whereToEat.body: Our favorite date spot for dinner and drinks whenever we’re in Lancaster.

whereToEat.heading: Southern Market
whereToEat.body: A restored 1888 marketplace serving lunch, dinner, and drinks food-court-style.

whereToEat.heading: Plough
whereToEat.body: Located inside the Lancaster Marriott at Penn Square, serving both lunch and dinner.

whereToEat.heading: 401 Prime
whereToEat.body: An upscale downtown dinner spot with a great lounge for drinks.

whereToEat.heading: Cabalar Meat Co.
whereToEat.body: Burger & sandwich spot that’s been on the top of our list to try.

whereToEat.heading: Spring House Brewing Co.
whereToEat.body: A local brewery with a full food menu, serving lunch and dinner.

whereToEat.heading: HiFi Izakaya
whereToEat.body: A Japanese listening lounge serving cocktails and small plates.

whereToEat.heading: Passerine
whereToEat.body: French-inspired small plates and a bottle shop.

whereToEat.heading: Proof
whereToEat.body: A speakeasy-style bar for cocktails, wines, and small plates.

whereToEat.heading: Rachel's Café & Creperie
whereToEat.body: A cozy downtown breakfast and lunch spot serving sweet and savory crêpes.

whereToEat.heading: The Lancaster Dispensing Co.
whereToEat.body: A casual downtown lunch and dinner spot.

whereToEat.heading: The Fridge
whereToEat.body: Casual lunch and dinner location serving craft beer and pizza.

activities.heading: Downtown Lancaster
activities.body: More on where to go and what to do near our wedding venue.

activities.heading: Lancaster Central Market
activities.body: A historic public market open Tuesday, Friday, and Saturday in Penn Square.

activities.heading: The Amish Village
activities.body: Farmhouse tours and backroads bus rides through Amish countryside. One of Sarah’s brothers, AJ, is the best tourguide there! ;)

activities.heading: Strasburg
activities.body: A charming small town 15 minutes outside Lancaster City where Sarah's family lived for years. We especially love Cherry Crest Farm!

activities.heading: Landis Valley Village & Farm
activities.body: A museum of Pennsylvania German history, heritage, and farming.

activities.heading: Waltz Vineyards
activities.body: A laid-back winery with outdoor seating.

rsvp.body: We’d love to know if you can make it, and we’re so grateful for your consideration. Please RSVP and make your meal selections by June 15, 2026 so we can plan accordingly.

registry.heading: Registry
registry.body: Your presence is by far the greatest gift, but if you’d like to contribute further, we're registered at the link below.

items.name: Our honeymoon
items.description: We’re heading to Cap Cana, Dominican Republic in September, and can’t wait to unwind after all the wedding excitement. If you’d like to contribute to our honeymoon fund, you can do so on our registry!

items.name: In the kitchen
items.description: We love hosting and cooking together, and we can’t wait to create more memories in the heart of our home.

items.name: Around the house
items.description: We're building a home together and we appreciate anything that helps us settle in.
